data.notes: February 2026 in Miami was unusually festival-heavy, with jazz, electronic, Latin, LGBTQ circuit, and guitar-focused events clustering in the second half of the month.

events.title: The Disco Biscuits: Jam Cruise 22 Pre-Party
events.summary: The Disco Biscuits played a Jam Cruise 22 pre-party at Miami Beach Bandshell, with the venue listing the show as open to cruisers and the general public.

events.title: La Invasión Tropical
events.summary: A one-night tropical Latin arena bill at Kaseya Center featuring Elvis Crespo, Víctor Manuelle, Jerry Rivera, Frank Reyes, El Blachy, Alex Sensation and Grupo Manía The Originals.

events.title: Digable Planets: Blowout Comb 30th Anniversary Tour
events.summary: Digable Planets brought their full-band Blowout Comb 30th anniversary show to Miami Beach Bandshell, with Mr. Manuvers listed for an opening DJ set on the event page.

events.title: CimaFest Miami 2026
events.summary: Cimafunk & La Tribu hosted two days of DJ sets, dance parties and full-band sets, with Cimafunk headlining both nights and guests including Buscabulla, Gia Fu, Bosq, Salsa Z and Los Datway.

events.title: Miami International GuitART Festival 2026
events.venueName: FIU Herbert and Nicole Wertheim Performing Arts Center
events.summary: The 11th Miami International GuitART Festival presented a week of concerts, masterclasses and luthier programming, with artists including René Izquierdo, Celil Refik Kaya, Deepak Ram and Freddie Bryant.

events.title: Premio Lo Nuestro 2026
events.summary: The 38th annual Premio Lo Nuestro awards show aired live from Kaseya Center, celebrating Latin music across pop, urbano, tropical and Mexican music categories with live performances announced by TelevisaUnivision.

events.title: Jamie Jones, Ilario Alicante + Miguelle & Tons at Club Space
events.summary: Club Space booked Jamie Jones, Ilario Alicante, Miguelle & Tons and Bakke for a Saturday-night Terrace event promoted by clubspacemiami.

events.title: Winter Party Festival 2026
events.summary: Winter Party Festival returned to Miami Beach for its 33rd year with more than a dozen LGBTQ+ music and dance events and DJs including Abel, GSP, Morabito, Sagi Kariv and Toy Armada.

events.title: Montreux Jazz Festival Miami 2026
events.venueName: Miami Beach Bandshell and The Hangar
events.summary: Montreux Jazz Festival Miami expanded to five nights, opening with Miles Davis centennial and Makaya McCraven programs before a main weekend featuring Trombone Shorty, Jon Batiste, Nile Rodgers & CHIC, TOTO, Bomba Estéreo and more.

events.title: We Belong Here Miami 2026
events.summary: We Belong Here Miami staged a three-day electronic festival at Historic Virginia Key Beach Park with headliners including Kaskade, Chris Lake, Lane 8, Tiësto, Gorgon City and Elderbrook.

events.title: Polo & Pan + Red Axes at Club Space
events.summary: Club Space listed Polo & Pan, Red Axes, Sinopoli, Bakke, Miluhska and Max Stern for a Friday-night Terrace event promoted by clubspacemiami.

events.title: Juvenile at The Fillmore Miami Beach
events.venueName: The Fillmore Miami Beach at Jackie Gleason Theater
events.summary: Juvenile’s official tour listing confirmed a February 28 Miami Beach concert at Backstage at The Fillmore Miami Beach, with an 8:00 p.m. showtime.
